# Repository Instructions

For visual interface, landing-page, dashboard, product-UI, and
presentation-deck work:

1. Read and follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md`.
2. Read and follow `design-system/routing.md`.
3. Treat `design-system/accessibility.yaml` and
   `design-system/core.md` as mandatory constraints.
4. Evaluate presentation work against
   `design-system/quality-bar.md`.
5. Preserve the existing application architecture, component
   library, design tokens, and brand requirements.

For non-design tasks, do not run the visual-style routing process.

Do not claim to have read files, run tests, or verified
accessibility unless you actually did so.

If required files cannot be accessed, report the limitation.
Do not invent their contents.

Do not create or modify a decision-log file unless requested.
